# Abdullah | AI Product Engineer

Full-Stack Engineer & AI Pipeline Architect specializing in building production-grade AI systems, SaaS platforms, and software that thinks.

## Roles
- **AI Product Engineer**: Bridging the gap between AI demos and production engineering.
- **AI Pipeline Architect**: Designing scalable RAG and LLM orchestration layers.
- **Full-Stack SaaS Builder**: Crafting immersive, high-performance web applications.

## Technical Stack
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15/16, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion, Spline 3D
- **Backend & Database**: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Redis (Upstash), Docker
- **AI**: OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, OpenRouter, Llama 3, Gemini
- **Infrastructure**: Vercel, Hetzner, Dockerized Playwright Swarms

## Featured Projects

### Fulfix
- **Description**: Agency-Grade Order Management System (OMS) for the Pakistani market.
- **Key Feature**: AI TrustScore™ using Llama 3 to predict RTO (Return to Origin) risks.
- **Stack**: Next.js, Supabase, OpenRouter, Upstash, WhatsApp Business API.
- **URL**: https://fulfix.pk

### ASAS Forge
- **Description**: Premium digital catalog for architectural hardware.
- **Key Feature**: RAG-powered conversational search for 10k+ SKUs.
- **Stack**: Next.js, Vercel AI SDK, RAG, jsPDF.
- **URL**: https://asasforge.com

### Arsalan Malik (Pitch)
- **Description**: Immersive Web3 hub with Spline 3D environments.
- **Key Feature**: Scroll-synced 3D animations and AI mentorship agents.
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, Spline, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS 4.
- **URL**: https://crypto-guru-omega.vercel.app/

### EchoHarvest
- **Description**: Industrial-grade distributed data harvesting infrastructure.
- **Key Feature**: 'Ghost Protocol' for bot evasion and serverless Playwright swarm on Docker.
- **Stack**: Next.js, Playwright, Docker, Redis.
